method.unit: Independent setup seed; seats averaged within each setup; deltas are candidate minus control.
method.intervals: Approximate paired Student-t 95% intervals. For n>41, critical value approximated as 1.96 + 2.372/(n-1); at n=100 this approximates t(99, .975). The same lower endpoint is a one-sided 97.5% lower bound. No clipping of paired delta intervals.
method.missing: Missing scheduled records are an error. Recorded capped/unresolved/illegal/error outcomes remain in completion and observed-win bounds; only fully complete paired setups enter win-share/margin analysis.
method.latency: Decision-weighted means include all available recorded decisions; paired game means are averaged across seats then independent setup seeds. Setups with any zero-decision game are excluded only from the paired latency estimate.
method.multiplicity: Hive has one prespecified primary completion test. Love Letter 2p/4p and Sushi Go 4p are three descriptive exploratory scaling strata; no promotions.

sensitivityWinShareDelta.note: Identification bounds with each incomplete game assigned any win share in [0,1]; not confidence intervals.

gate.note: Three exploratory strata; descriptive 95% intervals are not multiplicity adjusted and do not establish confirmation or promotion.
